messages:
Sofia (docs): Hey all, my docs PR #4526 is blocked by preview. The streaming page example still shows `timeout_ms` and claims the server enforces a 60s timeout. Can runtime confirm current defaults and any Dedicated exceptions?

preview-bot: Deploy preview 4526 00build failed. Linkcheck: broken anchor /api/streaming#timeouts (404). Example test failed: streaming-example.test.js. Logs: https://deploy.example/4526/logs

Noah (runtime): Short answer: hosted default is 120s. We removed client `timeout_ms` in SDK v1.3.0; clients should use AbortController or SDK cancellation helpers.

Sofia (docs): Thanks. The PR uses a JS snippet copied from older docs: `client.stream({ model, timeout_ms: 60000 })`. I also see the doc text says "server timeout: 60s" which conflicts.

Asha (sdk): Correct, SDK stopped accepting `timeout_ms` in 1.3.0. We added `client.withTimeout(ms, fn)` in 1.4.0 and the AbortSignal pattern is recommended. Please pin examples to @redwood/sdk@1.5.1 or later.

Mark (platform): Note on Dedicated: new Dedicated pools default to 120s too, but legacy Dedicated pools created before the Feb standardization can still be 60s. If a customer hasn't migrated their pool profile they might observe 60s. We should add a short backcompat callout and point to support/SE for migrations.

Noah (runtime): I'll provide a one-line snippet for the docs explaining the authoritative sources: hosted control plane = 120s; check your deployment profile for Dedicated legacy configs. That should be enough to resolve the contradiction.

Sofia (docs): Plan: 1) replace `timeout_ms` example with AbortController + mention `client.withTimeout` helper, 2) pin the code sample to v1.5.1, 3) add a tiny callout: "Hosted default 120s; legacy Dedicated pools may be 60s. Contact support for exceptions." 4) fix the anchor id. I'll push changes in ~25m.

Asha (sdk): Once pushed I can run a quick sanity check on the snippet. Also add a one-line Python cancellation example if possible.

preview-bot: Build queued for deploy-preview 4527.

preview-bot: Deploy preview 4527 - success. Linkcheck fixed. Example test passed.

Asha (sdk): Snippet looks good and uses v1.5.1 helpers. Python example LGTM too.

Mark (platform): LGTM on the wording. Thanks for adding the backcompat note.

Sofia (docs): Merged. Thanks everyone :tada:
